info.title: Public API
info.description:
OCR Gateway exposes a set of document analysis operations through the HTTP interface. Below are presented operations that can be used to interact with the OCR Gateway platform. # Authentication Our API puts some restrictions on the data submitted to the endpoints. Passing data that doesn't match these requirements will lead to undefined behaviour or sometimes to the HTTP Bad Request responses.

General payload limitations
     The maximum allowed document size is 10 MiB.
     Documents must not have any security restrictions such as password protection

Document limitations
Supported MIME types:
    `application/pdf`
    `image/jpeg`
    `image/png`
    `image/tiff`


We recommend the 640 x 480 pixels resolution for documents and images to achieve the most accurate results.

404.description: Document with provided id not found

post.description:
Upload a file for extraction. The file wil be enqueued for processing.
The processed document will be available after text extraction and completing all workflow steps.

Returns processed document id

get.description:
Get page of documents (only full processed and rejected will be included).

This method accepts the `q` parameter, which is a search query combining NAME or DATA search terms.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The maximum number of files to return per page. Partial or empty result pages are possible even before the end of the files list has been reached. Acceptable values are 1 to 100, inclusive

parameters.name: hubId
parameters.description: The hub id used for document processing

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Specifies the start date for filtering documents that have been transitioned to the Processed status

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Specifies the end date for filtering documents that have been transitioned to the Processed status

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Column by which documents will be filtered

parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.description: The source from which the document was downloaded

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A query for filtering the results.

get.description:
Gets a document's data by ID.
Returns a list of field objects and Information about document.

Processed files support pre-processing steps: deskew, dewarp, fixlayout.
